We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. As an AI Expert and Architect, you will design and deliver intelligent systems that power large-scale AI capabilities across SAP’s ecosystem. You will take ideas from concept to production, building robust services, APIs, and agentic workflows that enable enterprise-grade AI applications in the real world. You will work across technology stack, using languages such as Go, Java, and Python, and technologies such as LangGraph, PostgreSQL, SAP HANA, and GraphQL. Your work will directly shape how AI is embedded into SAP products, driving smarter automation, better decision-making, and improved customer experiences. You will tackle challenges related to scalability, performance, and reliability while integrating advanced AI capabilities into enterprise environments. In parallel, you will help define technical standards, guide architectural decisions, and mentor engineers to ensure innovation translates into high-quality, production-ready systems. As an AI Expert and Architect, you’ll architect and deliver intelligent systems that power large-scale AI capabilities across SAP’s ecosystem. You’ll take ideas from concept to production, building robust services, APIs, Agentic Workflows & user experience that enable real-world, enterprise-grade AI applications. You’ll design and optimize systems across a modern technology stack, working with languages such as Go, Java, and Python, and technologies like Langgraph, Postgres, HANA, and graphql. Your work will directly impact how AI is embedded into SAP products, driving smarter automation, better decision-making, and enhanced customer experiences. You’ll tackle challenges around scalability, performance, and reliability while integrating advanced AI capabilities into enterprise environments. In parallel, you’ll help define technical standards and mentor engineers, ensuring innovation translates into high-quality, production-ready systems. What you bring You bring deep technical expertise, a strong sense of ownership, and a track record of delivering complex systems at scale. Experience · 10+ years of software engineering experience, delivering ML or AI solutions in production · Proven experience architecting scalable systems, APIs, and data platforms · Hands-on programming experience in Go, Java, or Python · Experience working with distributed systems technologies (e.g., messaging systems, databases, RPC frameworks) · Practical experience applying AI/ML techniques, including LLMs, in real-world products · Experience leading initiatives end-to-end—from design through deployment and optimization · Strong exposure to CI/CD, testing practices, and cloud-native architectures · Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in global environments · Track record of mentoring engineers and fostering technical excellence You are someone who · Thrives in ambiguous environments and solves complex technical problems · Takes ownership and drives ideas into impactful outcomes · Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively across teams · Balances deep technical expertise with a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset Nice to have · Experience integrating AI into large-scale enterprise platforms · Contributions to open-source or engagement in the AI/ML community · Full-stack or platform engineering experience Where you belong You’ll join a high-performing, collaborative team building cutting-edge AI systems with global reach. The culture is high-trust and high-autonomy, where engineers are empowered to take ownership and move quickly without unnecessary bureaucracy. You’ll work closely with product leaders, engineers, and architects to turn bold ideas into scalable solutions. The team values continuous learning, technical excellence, and a shared commitment to innovation. This is a place where you can: · Shape the future of AI within a global enterprise · Work on impactful systems used by customers worldwide · Collaborate with experienced engineers and AI experts · Grow your technical and leadership capabilities in a fast-paced environment #SAPReturnshipIndiaCareers Bring out your best    SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.       We win with inclusion    SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.  SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.  For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the    SAP Employee Referral Program  , according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.  Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity,  gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.     Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor. AI Usage in the Recruitment Process For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our    Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process   . Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.
